method: Explicit uncompleted/never-opened source tags and a small reviewed name exclusion list. This is a conservative audit rather than proof that all other lifecycle-tagged remnants once carried trains.

sources.evidence: Hakodate City describes construction followed by cancellation; never opened.
Hamada City describes the old and new unfinished lines and their surviving structures.
Saga Prefectural Government Archives classifies the former JNR Yobuko project as uncompleted.
MLIT describes the extension beyond Ohata to Oma as an unfinished line.
JA Shizuoka describes the unfinished railway project and former tunnel now reused for wine storage.
Railway Forum historical-line bibliography identifies this as an uncompleted line.

Akamura states the original project was never used, while its later tourist trolley opened in 2003. Original abandoned project sections without later-use evidence are excluded when source tags say never opened.
